headline_marked: Mirpur-10: [[DNCC vehicles torched]] during footpath eviction drive
headline: Mirpur-10: DNCC vehicles torched during footpath eviction drive
summary: Footpath vendorsy sparked violent clashes with authorities, leading to the burning of city corporation garbage trucks and police vehicles.
details: A violent clash erupted in the Mirpur-10 roundabout area of Dhaka after the Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) conducted an eviction drive to remove illegal footpath occupations.
The incident occurred on Wednesday morning when a DNCC mobile court, accompanied by police, attempted to clear the footpaths.
Angry footpath vendors attacked the authorities, vandalizing and setting fire to several vehicles, including DNCC garbage trucks and a police vehicle.
The attacks left several police officers and members of the media injured.
Witnesses reported that tension remained high until nearly 12:00 PM, during which police fired tear gas shells to disperse the crowd.
Footpath vendors responded by throwing bricks and stones at the police, eventually forcing the law enforcement officers to retreat due to the vendors' superior numbers.
caption:
Vehicles torched and tear gas fired in Mirpur-10 as footpath vendors clash with DNCC authorities.

A violent clash erupted in the Mirpur-10 roundabout area of Dhaka after the Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) conducted an eviction drive to remove illegal footpath occupations.

The incident occurred on Wednesday morning when a DNCC mobile court, accompanied by police, attempted to clear the footpaths.

Angry footpath vendors attacked the authorities, vandalizing and setting fire to several vehicles, including DNCC garbage trucks and a police vehicle.

The attacks left several police officers and members of the media injured.

Witnesses reported that tension remained high until nearly 12:00 PM, during which police fired tear gas shells to disperse the crowd.

Footpath vendors responded by throwing bricks and stones at the police, eventually forcing the law enforcement officers to retreat due to the vendors' superior numbers.

headline_marked: 40 [[active Awami League members held]] in Dhaka raids
headline: 40 active Awami League members held in Dhaka raids
summary: Dhaka Metropolitan Police arrested 40 members of the banned party in raids across the capital on Wednesday.
details: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) arrested 40 active members of the Awami League on Wednesday.
The arrests were carried out during raids across various parts of the capital city.
The DMP's Deputy Commissioner (Media and Public Relations) Akhtar Hossain confirmed the operation.
Police stated that legal proceedings against those arrested are currently underway.
In a broader 24-hour operation, the DMP arrested 401 people and filed 26 cases.
caption:
40 active members of the banned Awami League arrested in Dhaka raids.

Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) arrested 40 active members of the Awami League on Wednesday.

The arrests were carried out during raids across various parts of the capital city.

Police stated that legal proceedings against those arrested are currently underway.

In a broader 24-hour operation, the DMP arrested 401 people and filed 26 cases.
